source_name: GovInfo Electronic Code of Federal Regulations explicit MATH blocks

official_access.access_mode: official GovInfo bulk XML, current eCFR XML file for each title
official_access.listing_rule: Traverse the official JSON/XML bulk listing; do not scrape individual eCFR HTML pages.

structures: explicit MATH elements / MathType equation blocks
scope.original_representation: serialized <MATH> XML plus referenced graphic URLs and nearby regulatory context
exclusions: No reconstruction of formula text from the image
No automatic conversion of prose thresholds or tables to equations in this lane

snapshot_policy.rule: Because eCFR is a mutable current editorial compilation, enumerate the complete official per-title XML inventory, record relative path, byte size and SHA-256 for every downloaded XML object, sort deterministically by path, and hash the canonical inventory. Use inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot; a wall-clock date alone is insufficient.

license_policy.rule: GovInfo states U.S. Government works are generally public domain under 17 USC 105 but publications can contain third-party copyrighted material. Publish Atlas-derived occurrence metadata, source XML wrappers and URLs with provenance; do not mirror or redistribute linked equation graphic bytes unless their rights are separately audited.

adapter.input: local mirror of official GovInfo eCFR XML files
validation: MATH element has an attested payload (attributes, text, or graphic reference)
No OCR or reconstruction is claimed by the extracted stage
Title, section, relative path and linked graphic references are preserved when available
